overall_summary: Development activity remains high with the release of ElizaOS v3 and new Solana trading plugins, though community communication gaps and recruitment spam have been noted. The project is focused on infrastructure hardening and expanding agent capabilities for household coordination.
key_facts: ElizaOS v3 was released and made available for cloning via the main GitHub repository.
PnL Labs released @pnllabs/plugin-pnllabs, a Solana trading plugin providing wallet trust scoring and token safety checks.
A legal lawsuit involving the project was dismissed with prejudice on July 8, 2026, following a settlement.
The GOATNetwork Builder Grants Program was announced, targeting teams building revenue-ready AI agent applications.
PR #17260 was merged to resolve critical failures in agent management and lifecycle deletion.
User cryptoteam.out cross-posted recruitment messages for the Shape3 ecosystem in multiple Discord channels, which was flagged as suspicious activity.
Development work on the 'Agentic Parent Suite' for household coordination is currently active in the repository.
PnL Labs audited 30 'smart money' wallets and found approximately 50% were losing money on-chain.
open_questions: How do I open a ticket? (Asked by _d0ctor_ in Discord on 2026-07-30)

overall_focus.claim: Focus on hardening core infrastructure and resolving critical production bugs to ensure framework resilience.
Development of monetization tools including influencer marketplaces and Stripe/OxaPay payment rails.

discord_updates.summary: Release of the pnllabs Solana trading plugin and associated smart money wallet audit results.
Community frustration regarding the inactivity of official communication channels since May 2026, contrasted with active GitHub development.

user_feedback.feedback_summary: Community members proposed a tokenomics model requiring users to lock tokens to access plugins to prevent sell-offs.
Concerns were raised about the lack of regular updates on X/Twitter and Farcaster.

strategic_insights.insight: There is a significant disconnect between rapid GitHub development and public-facing social presence, which is causing community uncertainty.
implications_or_questions: Does the team need a dedicated communications manager to bridge the GitHub-to-Discord gap?

market_analysis.observation: PnL Labs audit suggests 'smart money' wallets in the Solana ecosystem are significantly less profitable than perceived.
market_analysis.relevance: Impacts the design of trading agents and trust scoring algorithms.
